# AGENTS.md — GitHub Actions

`ci.yml` is pull-request-only and runs the Eightfold gates — frozen install, lint, typecheck, test, and build — on hosted `ubuntu-latest` with Node 22 and pnpm 11.7.0. The upstream master drill workflows (`ci-master.yml` and the Windows/Wine and Python runtime lanes) remain vendored but are not part of the Eightfold pull-request verdict; `ci-master.yml` listens on `refs/heads/master` and never fires from the Eightfold `main` branch. A job a workflow defines for a given event is listed and shows `skipped` when its `if` is false; keeping master-only jobs in a separate workflow stops PR check circles from showing gray segments.
